description.en: A fossil fertile branch bears clustered rounded sporangia alongside separately preserved vegetative material.
description.zh: 化石育性枝带成簇圆孢子囊，营养叶材料另行保存。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Botrychium wightonii, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Botrychium wightonii 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Branching sporangial panicle offers a bead-cluster silhouette absent from ordinary fern fronds.
distinctness.zh: 分枝孢子囊圆锥簇具有普通蕨叶没有的串珠簇轮廓。

modeling_brief.en: Model one documented fertile fragment in shallow relief; never join unattached vegetative pieces into an asserted whole plant.
modeling_brief.zh: 以浅浮雕呈现一件已记录育性残片，不把未相连营养片段拼成确定整株。

uncertainty: The fertile and vegetative fragments are not organically connected; complete plant is unknown.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Fossil Ophioglossales in the Paleocene of western North America
sources.supports: Botrychium wightonii fertile and vegetative fragments.
